name: kb-capture
description: Daily capture for an Open Knowledge Format knowledge base: start-of-day briefs that pull your calendars and inbox, live meeting notes, Granola meeting transcripts matched against the calendar event, and voice notes, all filed into raw/ as ordinary sources. Ships the Granola MCP server. Calendars and mail accounts are configured per bundle in the [capture] table of okf.toml, so nothing about your accounts is built into the skills.
